stories.title: Indonesia volcano eruption strands 340,000 as airports begin reopening
stories.summary: Anak Krakatau's weekend eruption disrupted Indonesian air travel, leaving about 340,000 passengers stranded as airports suspended or extended closures. Indonesian airports are resuming operations as volcanic ash clears and stranded travelers seek refunds.

stories.title: World shares and US futures decline, while oil prices press higher
stories.summary: Global stock indexes and US futures slid Tuesday while Brent crude gained 1.5% to about $98 a barrel, as tensions in the six-month US-Iran war kept supply worries in focus. Investors are also weighing tariff-driven uncertainty in the world economy.

stories.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs on $20bn of US goods take effect
stories.summary: Ottawa's counter-tariffs on roughly $20 billion of American products kicked in Tuesday after trade talks collapsed, escalating the strain on the world's largest bilateral trading relationship. Canada paired the move with a $7.5 billion support package for affected businesses and workers.

stories.title: Flight recorders recovered from Amazon cargo plane crash in Miami
stories.summary: Investigators recovered the flight data and cockpit voice recorders from the Amazon-contracted Boeing 767 that overshot Miami's runway, killing five. The plane traveled about 1,300 feet past the paved surface before coming to rest.

stories.title: Alibaba, Cambricon and Ant Group join PyTorch Foundation governance
stories.summary: The PyTorch Foundation named Alibaba Cloud and Cambricon as Platinum members, earning each a Governing Board seat, and Ant Group as a Gold member, announced at PyTorch Conference China in Shanghai. The additions broaden the open-source AI stack's governance across major Chinese firms.

stories.title: Anthropic walks away from $6 billion Decart acquisition
stories.summary: Anthropic ended talks to acquire Israeli AI startup Decart after due diligence, dropping what would have been its largest known acquisition at roughly $6 billion, about a 50% premium to Decart's last private valuation. The pullback comes as Anthropic prepares for a possible IPO as early as October.

stories.title: 4 Reasons To Feel Optimistic About the Cleveland Browns' 2026 Season
stories.summary: An SI preview lays out four reasons for optimism ahead of the Browns' Week 1 trip to Jacksonville: a rebuilt offensive staff, expected second-year leaps from young playmakers, a promising recent draft core, and the NFL's easiest schedule (only three 2025 playoff teams). The team opens Sunday at the Jaguars.

stories.title: The star power of Ohio State's freshmen in Saturday's win over Ball State
stories.summary: A recap zeros in on Ohio State's true freshmen in the 56-3 season-opening rout of Ball State, headlined by running back Legend Bey, as the No. 1 Buckeyes prep for this week's trip to No. 5 Texas.

stories.title: Texas braces for rematch with No. 1 Ohio State
stories.summary: No. 1 Ohio State travels to Austin to face No. 5 Texas on Saturday night — its first road game of the season and only the sixth all-time meeting between the programs. Defensive lineman Hero Kanu, who played for both schools, called it a 'playoff-caliber' game and noted the Buckeyes won the last two meetings.

stories.title: Tost defends 2026 F1 rules despite driver criticism
stories.summary: Former Toro Rosso boss Franz Tost, now a Red Bull consultant, defended Formula 1's 2026 energy-management regulations against driver criticism, arguing the racing was foreseeable and entertaining. He also called Kimi Antonelli's title form 'fantastic' and expects Lewis Hamilton to extend his contract.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov 1.1.5.0 patch notes unveiled
stories.summary: Battlestate Games released the full 1.1.5.0 patch notes, overhauling the Lighthouse map with new route variants and underground passages, changing how Lightkeeper is accessed, and altering core mechanics tied to the Icebreaker transition.

stories.title: 911 services return in Columbus area after hourlong interruption
stories.summary: Columbus-area 911 services were restored Tuesday morning after roughly an hour-long interruption affecting callers across central Ohio.

stories.title: Invasive insect sightings on the rise in central Ohio
stories.summary: Central Ohio is reporting more invasive insect sightings, with agencies directing residents to Ohio guidance on managing pests like the spotted lanternfly on their property.

stories.title: COTA launches new route from Hilliard to Downtown
stories.summary: COTA launched Line 30 on Monday, a new fixed route connecting Downtown Columbus with Ohio State, Upper Arlington and Hilliard, running every 30 minutes seven days a week as part of the LinkUS transit plan.
